title: Ticket triage — demo (fictional data)

decisions.question: TKT-201: Login loop after password reset
decisions.context_md:
| | |
|---|---|
| Site | app.example.com |
| Priority | High |
| Reporter | Support (via customer) |
| Age | 4 days |
| Status | Fix ready |

### Original ticket
> Users who reset their password get bounced back to the login screen in a loop. Started after last week's deploy. ~30 users/day per support logs.

### Comments
> **Support** · day 1 — Generating daily calls, can we prioritize?
>
> **PM** · day 1 — Bumped to High. Reproduced on staging with a fresh account.

### Evidence
- Loom walkthrough: https://www.loom.com/share/example-login-loop
- Repro recording (local): file:///tmp/decision-tui-demo/login-loop.txt

### Work history
- Reproduced on staging: loop occurs only when the reset is started from the marketing subdomain
- Root cause: session cookie set with `domain=www.example.com` but the reset flow lands on bare `example.com` — cookie never matches, auth check fails, redirect to login
- Fix: normalize cookie domain to `.example.com`
- Regression check: existing sessions unaffected (cookie name unchanged); verified logout/login on both hosts

### Proposed fix
```diff
- set_cookie(name, value, domain='www.example.com', secure=True, httponly=True)
+ set_cookie(name, value, domain='.example.com',     secure=True, httponly=True)
```

options.label: Approve — open PR
options.description: One-line cookie-domain fix, repro confirmed, low risk

options.label: Send to review
options.description: Wants a second set of eyes on the auth path

decisions.question: TKT-188: Payment webhook timeouts causing duplicate charges
decisions.context_md:
| | |
|---|---|
| Site | Billing service |
| Priority | Critical |
| Reporter | Finance (duplicates flagged) |
| Age | 2 days |
| Status | Fix drafted — touches payments |

### Original ticket
> Three customers were charged twice this week. The payment provider's dashboard shows the webhook endpoint timing out and the provider retrying — both attempts processed.

### Comments
> **Finance** · day 1 — Refunded the duplicates manually. Need this stopped before the next billing run.
>
> **PM** · day 1 — Critical. Do NOT ship to the payment path without review.

### Work history
- Traced the timeout: the webhook handler does a CRM sync inline — CRM p95 is ~9s, the provider gives 10s before retry
- No idempotency check on `payment.succeeded`, so the retry re-runs the charge flow
- Fix drafted: (1) record processed event ids, skip duplicates; (2) move the CRM sync to a queued job so the webhook ACKs in <1s
- LOW confidence flagged on the queue choice: the service has no existing job runner; this fix adds one

### Proposed fix (summary)
```text
new table: processed_events (event_id PK, processed_at)
webhook: insert-or-skip on event_id, enqueue crm_sync, return 200
new worker: drains the crm_sync queue
```

options.label: Approve — open PR
options.description: Idempotency + queued sync; stops the duplicates

options.label: Send to review
options.description: Payment path + a new job runner — get review before shipping

options.label: Split it
options.description: Ship the idempotency check now; defer the queue

decisions.question: TKT-176: Color contrast failures on stat cards (WCAG AA)
decisions.context_md:
| | |
|---|---|
| Site | Design system |
| Priority | Medium (compliance) |
| Reporter | Accessibility audit |
| Age | 12 days |
| Status | Fix ready |

### Original ticket
> Automated audit: the stat-card component fails AA — white text on the brand accent `#4DB6AC` is 2.9:1, needs 4.5:1. Affects 14 pages.

### Work history
- A darker accent `#00796B` already exists in the palette as `--accent-700` and hits 5.1:1 with white text
- Fix: swap the card background token; no new colors introduced
- Visual diff generated for all 14 pages — layout unchanged, only the card background deepens
- Audit re-run on the branch: 0 contrast failures remain

### Proposed fix
```css
.stat-card {
-  background: var(--accent-500); /* #4DB6AC — 2.9:1 */
+  background: var(--accent-700); /* #00796B — 5.1:1 */
}
```

options.label: Approve — open PR
options.description: On-palette token swap, audit passes, visual diffs attached

options.label: Send to review
options.description: Design wants to confirm the token choice

options.label: Hold
options.description: Bundle with a larger design-system pass later
